interpretation: All U0 predictor scores are out-of-fold by class. The P2B map is a non-learned baseline evaluated on the same frozen patch set; no Phase2B or K1 parameter receives a utility-model gradient.

pre_registered_protocol.gate: q=selected held-out utility log-odds; q<=0 -> g=0; q>0 -> g=sigmoid(q)
pre_registered_protocol.models: balanced L2 logistic regression; only if its OOF anomaly AUROC does not exceed P2B, one fixed 2->4->1 Tanh MLP (AdamW lr=.02, 300 full-batch CPU steps); no feature or hyperparameter sweep

provenance.precision: frozen FP32 inference; CPU utility fitting
